name: Kurusu Michiru
source:
The leader figure of the children who have lost their way into the mansion. Her gentle and kind attitude, on top of doing everything in the mansion, makes her an obvious choice when you need help. Does everything in her might to keep the peace/protect the happiness of the mansion, even if it meant being feared by a few individuals living with her…

[From [url=http://whatistomato.wordpress.com/2011/12/04/midori-no-umi-review/]Warum's review[/url]]
